name: Halcyon
subtitle: A free, private sleep tracker for iPhone.
description: Halcyon notices when you fall asleep, scores your night and catches snoring. Everything stays on your iPhone.

apps.name: Halcyon
apps.subtitle: Sleep tracking that stays on your phone.
apps.localizedDescription: Tap the bedtime reminder, put your phone down, and Halcyon does the rest: minute-by-minute sleep stages, a sleep score out of 100, snoring and sleep-talk clips, a smart alarm and gentle late-night nudges. No account, no server, no analytics.

versions.localizedDescription: First beta. Please send feedback from Settings › Send feedback.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Listens on this iPhone for snoring, sleep talk and room noise while you sleep. Audio never leaves your phone.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Notices when your phone is put down or picked up, to tell when you fell asleep and woke up.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Reads Apple Watch sleep stages, heart rate and HRV to make your sleep reports more accurate.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Saves each night's sleep stages to Apple Health, if you turn this on.
